title: Participles: a parsing routine
subtitle: Read form, agreement, and function in that order.
overview: Parse tense/aspect, voice, gender, number, case, antecedent, and function before translating.
A translation comes last: first show which noun the participle agrees with and whether it is attributive or circumstantial.
